scope: Computational artificial-life research: integer programs on a bounded virtual machine, search operators and simulated populations of software objects. No biological material, organism, procedure or design of any kind.
readouts: per ruler: mean loss, log-length slope (permutation band), set effect tops vs rest (relabel), for loss and for absolute reward change
reading: RULER_DEPENDENT if the length slope or the set effect differs in significance or sign between (i) and any of (ii), (iv), (v); (iii) is the known-dilution reference
material_rule: RULER_DEPENDENT, or (iii) differs from (i) as D084 predicts (a positive control on the ruler defect)
